t: Authorizing Lease of Certain City Owned Land Near Twin Peaks.

The liens heretofore placed by the Board of Supervisors of the City and County of San Francisco in Santa Clara County are released against the properties described as follows: Rose Geist, recorded Santa Clara County August 12, 1936, Book 786, p. 87…
Bill No.3378, authorizing the Director of Property to arrange for leasing a certain tract of City-owned land containing an area of 50,544 square feet more or less…
